_note: Machine-checked rules for every Ameya Heights draft. Errors block the draft from the queue. Sources: owner fact pass (Oct 2026), Brand Canon (13 Jul 2026), owner decisions of 21 Oct 2026. Only the owner edits this file. Oct 2026 effectiveness pass (118 real captions): added column-free paraphrases, RERA/booking, public-documents, scarcity, appreciation, unlisted-fact, title, placeholder and completion-date rules. 21 Oct 2026 team-trial pass: refusals ("not for sale", "aren't taking bookings", "won't take any advance") no longer trip the sale/booking checks; "until/once approvals are in place" passes; plural bookings/prices; added %-a-year and annual-yield returns, reserve/secure/first-in-line, few-left/going-fast/demand, approved-by-DTCP, handing-over/ready-to-move, many-families social proof; Brigade Road allowed. The linter also reads content.title, template params and lead.requirement.

_negation_note: Combos and the booking/deposit rule skip a sale or booking word that directly follows a refusal (not, no, never, aren't, isn't, won't, don't, can't, cannot), allowing up to three filler words from a fixed list (be, yet, currently, taking, accepting, offered, available, for, any, a, the ...). "No need to buy" or "never been easier to book" still fire because their middle words are not on the list.
